en.title: Kids Birthday Party Cost in Dubai 2026 | Eventana
en.description: What a kids birthday party actually costs in Dubai: packages AED 2,199–5,999 for 4 hours and 40 children, decor from AED 1,500, delivery AED 280. Real prices, no enquiry needed.
en.intro: Most party companies in Dubai make you enquire before they tell you a price. Here is Eventana's, in full. A complete party package runs 4 hours and covers up to 40 children, and costs between AED 2,199 and AED 5,999 depending on what is included. Decor-only setups — a styled backdrop with balloon work, no food stations or entertainers — start at AED 1,500. On top of the package there is one delivery fee that depends on the emirate, from AED 280 in Dubai to AED 660 in Fujairah. Everything else is optional and priced individually, so a party is as simple or as full as you want it. Note that some companies advertise from AED 299 or AED 499: those are decor-only prices for a backdrop, not a staffed four-hour party — worth checking what a quote actually covers before comparing.

faq.q: What is the cheapest full party package?
faq.a: Movie Night at AED 2,199. It runs 4 hours, covers up to 40 children and includes 5 items — the themed backdrop, balloon decor and a projection screen among them.

faq.q: What do the six packages cost?
faq.a: Movie Night AED 2,199, Bronze Birthday AED 3,599, Silver Birthday AED 4,799, Summer Party AED 4,999, Spa Party AED 5,999 (up to 20 girls) and Golden Birthday AED 5,999. All run 4 hours and, apart from Spa, cover up to 40 children.

faq.q: How much is decoration on its own?
faq.a: A small styled backdrop with balloon work is AED 1,500, a medium AED 1,650 and a giant backdrop AED 2,200. No package required.

faq.q: What does delivery cost?
faq.a: Dubai AED 280, Sharjah and Ajman AED 380, Abu Dhabi AED 420, Umm Al Quwain AED 480, Al Ain and Ras Al Khaimah AED 530, Fujairah AED 660. One fee per booking, covering delivery, setup and collection.

faq.q: How much are the food stations?
faq.a: Popcorn AED 780, cotton candy AED 780, ice cream AED 900, corn AED 900, slush AED 950, hot dog AED 1,200, pancake AED 1,500, burger sliders AED 1,500, hot chocolate AED 1,500, nachos AED 1,600, chocolate fountain AED 2,200. Each runs 4 hours for up to 40 guests and is operated by Eventana staff.

faq.q: How much do entertainers and inflatables add?
faq.a: Face painting AED 950, balloon twisting AED 950, a costumed mascot AED 950, an acrobat clown AED 1,500. A 4x4m bouncy castle is AED 1,100, a bubbles house AED 1,500, the Amwaj slide AED 1,250 and a 12x6m slippery football pitch AED 1,100.

faq.q: So what is a realistic total?
faq.a: A common booking is a mid package plus a bouncy castle and two food stations: Silver Birthday AED 4,799 + castle AED 1,100 + popcorn AED 780 + cotton candy AED 780 + Dubai delivery AED 280 = AED 7,739. A simple one is Movie Night AED 2,199 + delivery AED 280 = AED 2,479. You can build either on the website and see the total before paying.
